title: Empty read buffer
statement: Let $E$ be an injective code from optional $[0m[0m\Gamma$ symbols into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, and let $r$ assign a scanned symbol or blank to each of $k$ tapes. After zero reading steps, every buffer entry on every tape is blank.
hypotheses_covered: Injective block code $E$ for optional $[0m[0m\Gamma$ symbols
Assignment $r$ of an optional $[0m[0m\Gamma$ symbol to each of $k$ tapes
replaced:
After zero reading steps the per-tape buffer (entries at offsets below the count taken
from the coded scanned symbols, blank elsewhere) is the all-blank block on every tape.
